headline: Ipswich and Nottingham Forest share points after first-half goals

sentences.text: Ipswich Town and Nottingham Forest drew 1–1 in the Premier League, with both goals coming before half-time.
Neco Williams put Nottingham Forest ahead in the 13th minute, and Julio Enciso equalised for Ipswich in the 41st.
Nottingham Forest had more shots, 17 to 7, but neither side found a second-half goal.
